shiftLock.slot: Small round cap on top-left corner of shifter console — pry off to access slot
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Small round cap on top-left corner of shifter console — pry off to access slot.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood, driver side.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Small round cap on top-left corner of shifter console — pry off to access slot.

tow.method: Lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.

alerts.warning: Always apply parking brake and chock wheels before releasing Park on any incline.
alerts.notes: Key interlock recall Service Bulletin 05-009 affects some units — verify recall was completed.

shiftLock.slot: Small slot near the gear selector base on the console — pry off plastic cap, insert key. DCT: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST for reliable operation — DCT cannot shift without power.
steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — DCT requires 12V power to shift reliably.
Connect jump pack — battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and select N.
WITHOUT POWER — shift lock slot (mechanical override only):
Locate the small plastic cap near the gear selector base on the console.
Pry off the cap with the ignition key or small flathead.
Insert key into the slot and press firmly. Press brake. Move selector to N.
NOTE: Even with mechanical override, DCT clutch packs will not disengage without power — this may not work reliably.
Apply parking brake.
DCT REQUIRES POWER: Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to N normally.
If mechanical slot is used without power: DCT transmissions may resist — apply steady firm pressure and hold for several seconds.

DUAL-CLUTCH TRANSMISSION (DCT): Power is strongly preferred to shift to neutral. DCT without power may not release — use flatbed if shift override fails.

steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — preferred for all variants.

Remove the engine covers (plastic trim panels on top of engine).
Locate the stub/shaft with two flat faces on the TOP of the ZF 9HP transmission.
Grip the stub with a small crescent wrench and rotate CLOCKWISE to disengage the parking pawl.
Someone must ride the vehicle to hold it in place while it is moved — it will re-engage when released.
FLATBED with dollies is the safer practical option if power cannot be restored.

Connect jump pack — battery under hood.

shiftLock.slot: Small cap near gear selector base on center console
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Small cap near gear selector base on center console.
Pry off cap with small flathead.
Insert key or thin flathead into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood, driver side.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.

tow.method: 2H: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Transfer case to 2H first. Flatbed preferred.
notes: Isuzu Trooper-based platform. Shift transfer case to 2H before road towing.

alerts.warning: Shift transfer case to 2H before road towing. 4WD modes will damage drivetrain on pavement.
alerts.notes: Isuzu Trooper platform. Transfer case must be in 2H for road towing. Avoid towing in 4H or 4L on dry pavement.

shiftLock.slot: Electronic push-button selector — same as 3rd gen ZF 9HP. NO CABIN OVERRIDE. Restore 12V power or use engine bay transmission stub procedure.
steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST.
Connect jump pack — battery under hood. Once powered, select N on push-button selector.
WITHOUT POWER: NO cabin override. See MDX 3rd Gen ZF 9HP engine bay stub procedure.
FLATBED with dollies if power cannot be restored.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — under hood. Use AGM-compatible jump pack.

Electronic selectors require power — mechanical override is last resort only.
SH-AWD: FLATBED PREFERRED.

tow.method: FLATBED ONLY — SH-AWD cannot be disabled. Wheel-lift with dollies on free-rolling axle if no flatbed.
notes: FULL-TIME AWD: Cannot disengage SH-AWD. Flatbed is safest. If using wheel-lift, dollies MUST be under the free-rolling axle.
